desc:
Kageyama critizes this move: "You have to take the earliest possible opportunity to get ahead." (Lessons in the Fundamentals of Go, page 70.)

It's slower than the alternatives, but more solid---it's harder for Black to aim at **R17**(<X:R17>). It can also be useful when top is very unimportant and White really needs sente to play on the right side, for example.
